Name: Tiles
Description: The number of repetitions on either axis. Controls how many times the input is tiled horizontally and vertically across the terrain.

Name: Compensate Height
Description: Adjusts the height of each tile to prevent elevation buildup at tile seams, ensuring a smoother and more seamless repeat pattern.

Name: Height
Description: Sets the maximum elevation for the repeated tiles, allowing you to control the overall height of the tiled output.
